eekes_ai_content.intro_empty: Tell the assistant what this page is about, or let it ask you. It proposes a structure first, then writes the page from your own blocks.
eekes_ai_content.intro: What should change on this page? Nothing is saved: changes go into the form and the preview, and you can undo them.
eekes_ai_content.catalog_missing: Tip: the blocks of this website have not been described yet. A developer can run "bin/adminconsole eekes:ai-content:analyze" so the assistant knows when to use which block.
eekes_ai_content.quick.create_page: Questions first, then an outline, then the page
eekes_ai_content.quick.rewrite_page: Clearer, shorter, another angle - you say how
eekes_ai_content.quick.rewrite_block: Pick a block and say what should change
eekes_ai_content.quick.seo: SEO title, description and excerpt from the content
eekes_ai_content.quick.translate: From another language of this page, same structure
eekes_ai_content.applied: In the form, not saved yet
eekes_ai_content.placeholder: Ask or describe what you want...
eekes_ai_content.placeholder_block: What should change in this block?
eekes_ai_content.budget: {spent} of {limit} of this month's AI budget used
eekes_ai_content.anything_else: Anything else the assistant should know? (optional)
eekes_ai_content.answer_freely: Answer in your own words instead
eekes_ai_content.remembered_for_site: Your answer is remembered for the whole website
eekes_ai_content.no_history: No earlier conversations on this page.
eekes_ai_content.new_snippets: {count, plural, one {# new snippet} other {# new snippets}}
eekes_ai_content.snippets_drafts: Created as drafts when you apply - publish them in Snippets to show them on the website.
eekes_ai_content.snippets_published: Created and published when you apply.
eekes_ai_content.snippets_failed: Some snippets could not be created; they were left out. Try Apply again.
eekes_ai_content.apply_to_create: Nothing is in the form yet: choose which new snippets to create below, then click Apply.
eekes_ai_content.smart_content_reload: The list in {fields} has its new filters and is saved with them, but keeps showing the old ones until you save and reload the page.
eekes_ai_content.plan_intro: Describe the pages you need - a section, a set of services, a campaign. The assistant asks what it needs, proposes a plan you can adjust, then writes every page and creates it as an unpublished draft below the right page.
eekes_ai_content.plan_intro_articles: Describe the articles you need - a series, news items, a set of how-tos. The assistant asks what it needs, proposes a plan you can adjust, then writes every article and creates it as an unpublished draft.
eekes_ai_content.plan_note: Every item is written by the assistant in a run of its own - about what writing one page costs - and created as an unpublished draft.
eekes_ai_content.create_drafts: Write and create {count, plural, one {# draft} other {# drafts}}
eekes_ai_content.plan_needs_input: Created with its title only: the assistant has a question, open it to answer
eekes_ai_content.plan_below: New pages go below "{title}", the page selected in the tree, unless you say otherwise.
eekes_ai_content.plan_interrupted: Not created: the planner was left while this one was being written.
eekes_ai_content.plan_page_missing: Not created: the page "{title}" it goes below was not created. Try that page again first.
eekes_ai_content.progress.tool.search_pa: Looking for pages to link to
eekes_ai_content.turn_running: The assistant is still working on your previous message. Wait for its reply first.
eekes_ai_content.plan_not_started: Not started: the planner was left before its turn.
